modules.title: CAD workflow
modules.description: Coordinate multi-stage CAD work: establish the authoritative design, select the required CAD, manufacturing or documentation skills, and retain revision-bound evidence. Use for a new CAD project, cross-tool work or an explicit workflow review; a small isolated edit does not need a full lifecycle.

modules.title: Onshape CAD
modules.description: Construct or revise native Onshape geometry with FeatureScript, preserve user features and stable assembly references, and verify the affected interfaces. Use for native Onshape design, retrofit or variant work.

modules.title: Onshape session bridge
modules.description: Operate the configured Onshape session bridge: reuse the signed-in local app, verify runtime and endpoint budgets, reconcile uncertain writes, and verify binary artifacts. Use only for live work through this adapter; local CAD file review needs no startup.

modules.title: Build123d / cad-khana
modules.description: Use the cad-khana Build123d wrapper for local parametrically generated parts, assembly assertions, geometric diagnostics, drawing and export. Apply when editing cad_khana scripts or interpreting its diagnostic output.

modules.title: FDM design & preparation
modules.description: Design or revise FDM parts in the selected CAD backend: choose the print pose, preserve mating interfaces, assess assembly access and fits, and inspect actual slicer output. Also use for preparing or comparing print files.

modules.title: CAD Joints
modules.description: Select, reconstruct or design mechanical connections between CAD parts, including printed sliding joints, dovetails, keyed scarfs and snap fits. Use for joint geometry, assembly paths, retention or comparative fit coupons; cosmetic seams and ordinary assembly illustration alone do not require this skill.

modules.title: CAD design system
modules.description: Define, apply or calibrate a reusable CAD design language with manufacturing and protected-interface profiles. Use for coherent part families, functional colours, edge and label rules, design screening or style coupons.

modules.title: CAD assembly manuals
modules.description: Create or regenerate illustrated assembly manuals from Onshape CAD using durable native stages, semantic parts, explicit inventory and a maintained rendering recipe. Use for manuals, stage planning, layout or rendering-style work.

modules.title: Fusion / fusion-khana
modules.description: Construct or revise Fusion designs using the existing fusion-khana source-program workflow, explicit volume balances and native assembly checks. Requires a configured running Fusion application; generic STL review does not require this skill.

modules.title: Scan → parametric CAD
modules.description: Reconstruct functional CAD from 3D scans: inspect and clean the source, register and orient it, fit primitives, distinguish base form from features, and compare the reconstruction with a meaningful reference surface.
